maddeler.e:
يرتجع (form VIII)
# يَرْتَجِعُ (yartajiʕu) /jar.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# يُرْتَجَعُ (yurtajaʕu) /jur.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# يَرْتَجِعَ (yartajiʕa) /jar.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
